## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The README still documents the old 30-second default, so it needs updating to match the new 60-second value; the parser change and its default-value test are otherwise consistent.

## Changes
This pull request raises `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT` in `app/cli.py` from 30 to 60 and updates `test_defaults` to expect 60. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` file at the repository root.

## Important
- app/cli.py:3 — comments — Update the README default timeout to 60 seconds — When a user runs the CLI without `--timeout`, requests now time out after 60 seconds, but `README.md:3` still says "Requests time out after 30 seconds unless you pass `--timeout SECONDS`." The changed line `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 60` makes that README sentence false. — Users and operators who rely on the README get the wrong default timeout when they plan around slow upstreams.
